description: Stored templates, newest first, a page at a time (pass next_cursor as cursor): name, alias, default language, which parts each language (en, fr) has, the published version, and whether the draft has unpublished changes. A template holds the text for each channel it is sent on, with variables. send_sms sends its SMS part with template (the id or alias), variables and language. get_template returns a template's content and declared variables. Templates are edited and published in the HonkIO dashboard. Each name is wrapped in an untrusted-content tag. Needs the email_templates read permission (the email:read scope on an OAuth connection).
name: list_templates
title: List templates
